title: Paze replaces PayPal on the Suns patch
text: Early Warning Services' Paze takes the jersey patch from the 2026-27 season, succeeding PayPal, whose logo had been on the jerseys every season since 2018.

source.name: Arizona Sports (KTAR): Phoenix Suns partner with Paze as team's new jersey patch sponsor
source.quote: The Suns’ previous jersey patch sponsor was PayPal, whose logo had been stitched on the team’s jerseys every season since 2018.
